mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals an easing monetary cycle that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or FEDFUNDS show no sustained decline below 1.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.1 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 4.0% in the trigger period or the rate increase is not sustained beyond 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in GDPC1 (GDP) and decrease in HOUST (industrial production) signals robust demand growth, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 and HOUST show the specified concurrent trend, or their correlation with returns falls below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates compress equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive during a monetary tightening cycle or FEDFUNDS rates do not rise by >0.5% over 3 months in such periods.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in the INDPRO supply index signals accommodative monetary policy and reduced inflationary pressures, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO shows sustained upward trend, or inflation data contradicts accommodative policy signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in monthly PAYEMS (employment) below 150,000 indicates weakening labor market strength, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 150,000 in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite PAYEMS dropping below 150,000 or the decline is not sustained beyond the month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (GDP) and RSAFS (dollar supply) signals robust demand growth and liquidity injection, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS show the specified concurrent upward trend, or their combined effect on returns is below 0.3.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low unemployment rates (UNRATE below 3.5%) reduce risk premium pressures, enabling positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite UNRATE being below 3.5% in late-cycle expansion periods or the late-cycle expansion is not active.
